purpose: Independent confirmation only. This manifest does not authorize an automatic production change.

holdout.sourceRule: Seal immutable source revisions and SHA-256 values before any holdout metric is calculated.
holdout.identityRule: Use only accepted Instructor UUID mappings that were known at the prediction cutoff. A display name is never an evaluation identity.
holdout.forecastRule: Use the last sealed prediction cutoff before each outcome Term. One holdout outcome unit has one forecast.
holdout.lateDataRule: Exclude corrections or records acquired after the holdout source revision is sealed. Report them in a later holdout instead.

courseEvaluation.primaryMetric: Equal-unit mean absolute error on the source rating scale

instructorEvaluation.primaryMetric: Equal-unit mean absolute error on the source rating scale
secondaryStrata: Instructor with more than one historical Course

instructor.rule: No Course-only challenger can claim an Instructor improvement. Any future Instructor challenger requires a new manifest before outcomes are inspected.

invariants: One evidence observation has one context row.
Instructor-role evidence maps to exactly one accepted Instructor UUID.
Shared Course-role or Review-role evidence has total allocation 1 across a teaching team.
Changing team size does not change total samples or total confidence.
Production defaults and exports do not change until a separate reviewed decision accepts a sealed holdout.
